turns.reply:
`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists every learner whose last login was 14 or more days ago. Run against the current data, it gives:

```
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         2026-08-11  (54 days ago)
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        2026-09-02  (32 days ago)
```

- **Ordering:** the longest-absent learner comes first, rather than alphabetical as in `list`, so the people most at risk are at the top.
- **Columns:** each row shows the last login date and days since, in place of the course list.
- **Threshold:** the 14 days is the `INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS` constant at the top of `roster.py`; a login exactly 14 days ago counts as inactive.

I also added the command to the usage text and to `README.md`.
